approval_basis: The proposed local EN-T1–T3 increment and public seams cover the frozen EN-01–04 contract when the conditions below are retained. This assessment does not replace any JEV decision receipt or approve future implementation behavior.

coverage.seam: Public package-manifest generation/verification CLI against temporary rooted package files, plus a post-build origin receipt validator.
must_preserve: Capture commit, tree and dirty state once in the build orchestrator before generated outputs and pass the immutable origin into Vite/package creation.
Manifest is closed and excludes its own hash; outer receipt binds the embedded manifest and packaged app/sidecar hashes.
Verify required app and sidecar, missing/tampered files, duplicates, absolute/traversal paths, and root escapes.
When an installer is produced, the outer receipt actually computes and verifies its hash; portable output may use installer_sha256 null.
Dirty or source-less output remains ineligible.

coverage.seam: Pure collector/export validator for allowlisting, closed schema, sanitization, null rules, ring capacity/drop counts, and sample order.
must_preserve: Bind the exact receipt identity/epoch/sequence to the React commit using one injected renderer monotonic clock.
Exercise rapid/reordered publishes, duplicates, and command-result snapshots.
Do not describe collector-only tests as proof that the real React commit lifecycle was observed.

coverage.seam: Offline exporter and frontend/sidecar mapping checks.
must_preserve: market_lag_ms remains apparent wall-clock age with unknown clock offset/uncertainty; do not subtract Python and renderer clocks.
GPU remains null; TTLs remain quote/trade/book/account = 5/30/2/60 seconds; preserve stale-context rejection and controls.

coverage.seam: Local validator over hash-bound fixtures for closed run/task/event/comparison schemas and independent stage states.
must_preserve: Reject browser/synthetic evidence promoted to native, incomplete or post-freeze pairs, unqualified origins, and gain lacking frozen B treatment plus prospective complete pairs.
Preserve failure evidence and set gain null throughout T1–T3.
Do not claim comparable gain until host/runtime equivalence limits are resolved in T5.

findings.finding: app/packaging/build_installer.py is a separate CPython/Tk package path with a different manifest and no Tauri multimarket UI plus separate engine sidecar.
findings.condition: Explicitly exclude this legacy route from the EN-eligible artifact set, leave it unchanged, and do not claim every supported packaging path is EN eligible.

findings.finding: The declared Node test command and dependencies do not currently provide a React DOM/test renderer mount seam. Existing tests do not mount the component.
findings.condition: Add a dependency-free real mount seam or report React lifecycle verification as untested. Collector tests alone do not establish post-commit useLayoutEffect behavior. Keep receipt and committed snapshot aligned; current passive prop mirroring and direct command-result state updates can lag or double-attribute.

findings.finding: Existing metricsExportPayload emits schema_version 1 with gpu_bytes, legacy gate names and measurement_scope, unlike the proposed strict v1 envelope.
findings.condition: Give the new export a distinct schema identity or explicitly preserve/handle compatibility. No in-repository consumer of the existing downloaded export was found.

findings.finding: The readiness record says the current pair validator does not enforce full host/runtime equality.
findings.condition: Keep this outside T1–T3 and do not claim comparable gain until a future protocol freezes or qualifies environment differences.

integration_assessment.safe_shape: Keep the EN delta stacked on the PR2/spec line at reviewed base 385e79119b75bb8ea0277e3b0cfcb1656f443fba.

integration_assessment.limitations: This isolated review did not inspect remote refs or make branch, merge, publication or integration changes. Do not replace main or silently combine the two architectures.
